Build SERVER LIFECYCLE extras — scheduled backups, reinstall-to-a-different-OS, and resize-down — for Nxeon at /opt/nxeon. Other agents edit OTHER areas concurrently — touch ONLY YOUR OWNED FILES.

## PRIMER
Next.js 15 + Prisma. `"use server"` = async-only. `import { db } from "@/lib/db"`; `import { requireUser } from "@/lib/auth"`. Ownership-check every server op (`db.server.findFirst({where:{id,userId}})`). Money = integer cents; credit = `db.$transaction([db.user.update({where:{id},data:{balanceCents:{increment:c}}}), db.walletTransaction.create({data:{userId:id,amountCents:c,description}})])`. Design: `.card`,`.input`,`.btn-*`,`.btn-danger`; `import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/primitives"`. `Server` NEW fields: `autoBackup Boolean`, `backupIntervalHours Int?`, `lastAutoBackup DateTime?`. Existing jobs incl. `REINSTALL`, `RESIZE`, `BACKUP_CREATE` (worker handles them). Enqueue a job: `db.job.create({ data:{ type, serverId, payload? } })`. Only ONE in-flight job per server (check none QUEUED/RUNNING before enqueuing). READ `lib/actions-server.ts` (existing resize/backup pattern) and `app/dashboard/servers/[id]/page.tsx` + `components/customer/ServerTabs.tsx` (you EDIT the page — it already has disk graph, rename, SFTP, restore sections; integrate cleanly).

## TASK
1. **Scheduled backups** — `components/customer/BackupSchedule.tsx` + a `setBackupSchedule(serverId, enabled, intervalHours)` action writing `autoBackup`/`backupIntervalHours`. `worker/backup-schedule.ts` exports `scheduledBackupSweep()`: find RUNNING servers with `autoBackup=true` whose `lastAutoBackup` is older than `backupIntervalHours` (and no in-flight job), enqueue a `BACKUP_CREATE` job, set `lastAutoBackup=now`. (Orchestrator wires the sweep into the worker loop.)
2. **Reinstall to a different OS** — `components/customer/ReinstallOs.tsx` + `reinstallToOs(serverId, osTemplateId)` action: validate the new OS is active and the server's plan meets its requirements, set `Server.osTemplateId`, enqueue a `REINSTALL` job. Strong "this ERASES all data" confirm.
3. **Resize-down** — `resizeServerDown(serverId, newPlanId)` action: allow moving to a SMALLER active plan (guard: new disk ≤ current disk — disks can't shrink on most hypervisors, so only allow if newPlan.diskGB >= current used or block disk-shrink with a clear message; CPU/RAM can shrink), enqueue a `RESIZE` job. Credit a prorated difference back to the wallet for the remainder of the term. `components/customer/ResizeDown.tsx`.
Mount all three by EDITING `app/dashboard/servers/[id]/page.tsx` (sole editor) into the Resize/Backups tabs.

## OWNED FILES (create/edit ONLY these)
CREATE: `lib/actions-server-lifecycle.ts` (`"use server"`), `components/customer/BackupSchedule.tsx`, `components/customer/ReinstallOs.tsx`, `components/customer/ResizeDown.tsx`, `worker/backup-schedule.ts`. EDIT (sole owner): `app/dashboard/servers/[id]/page.tsx`, `components/customer/ServerTabs.tsx`.

## HARD RULES
Never touch schema/next.config/layouts/Shell/lib/auth/db/rbac/worker/index.ts/worker/billing.ts/lib/actions.ts/lib/actions-server.ts(read-only)/ROADMAP/docs or others' files. No build/prisma/generate/restart/commit. No new deps. `"use server"` = async-only. Ownership-checked; never shrink a disk destructively.

## REPORT
Files created/edited; how schedule/reinstall/resize-down work (and the disk-shrink guard + proration); INTEGRATION NEEDED (wire `scheduledBackupSweep()` into the worker loop); risks / live-VM testing needed.

model Plan {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  slug          String   @unique
  name          String
  cpuCores      Int
  ramMB         Int
  diskGB        Int
  bandwidthTB   Float    @default(1)
  priceCents    Int
  storageTier   String   @default("nvme") // "nvme" | "hdd"
  active        Boolean  @default(true)
  sortOrder     Int      @default(0)
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  servers       Server[]
  gamePlans     GamePlan[]
}

enum ImageCategory {
  PLAIN_OS
  CONTROL_PANEL
  APPLICATION
}

/// An installable image shown in the deploy wizard. Plain OS clones `baseVmid`
/// directly; control panels / apps clone `baseVmid` then run `setupScript`
/// (cloud-init runcmd) to install the panel/app on first boot.
model OsTemplate {
  id            String        @id @default(cuid())
  slug          String        @unique
  name          String        // display name, e.g. "Ubuntu"
  category      ImageCategory @default(PLAIN_OS)
  family        String        @default("linux") // ubuntu | debian | almalinux | rocky | cpanel | ...
  version       String        @default("")      // "24.04", "13", ""
  logo          String        @default("")      // icon slug for the UI
  vmid          Int           // legacy/base template VMID to clone
  baseVmid      Int?          // explicit base OS template for panels/apps (falls back to vmid)
  setupScript   String?       // shell installed via cloud-init runcmd (panels/apps)
  minRamMB      Int           @default(1024)
  minDiskGB     Int           @default(10)
  licenseRequired Boolean     @default(false)   // e.g. cPanel/Plesk need a paid license
  featured      Boolean       @default(false)
  sortOrder     Int           @default(0)
  active        Boolean       @default(true)
  servers       Server[]
}

model Server {
  id            String       @id @default(cuid())
  name          String
  label         String?      // customer-facing nickname (rename)
  hostname      String
  vmid          Int?         @unique
  status        ServerStatus @default(PENDING)
  ipAddress     String?      @unique
  sshPort       Int?         @unique
  rootPassword  String?
  isFree        Boolean      @default(false)
  autoRenew     Boolean      @default(true)
  suspendedNote String?
  expiresAt     DateTime?
  createdAt     DateTime     @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime     @updatedAt
  userId        String
  user          User         @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  nodeId        String?
  node          Node?        @relation(fields: [nodeId], references: [id])
  bwInBytes     BigInt       @default(0)
  bwOutBytes    BigInt       @default(0)
  bwWindowStart DateTime     @default(now())
  termMonths    Int          @default(1) // 1=monthly, 12=annual, 24=biennial, 36=triennial
  addons        Json         @default("{}") // { malwareScanner, dailyBackup, docker }
  dedicatedIp   DedicatedIp?
  wantsDedicatedIp Boolean   @default(false)
  projectId     String?
  project       Project?     @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  planId        String
  plan          Plan         @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id])
  osTemplateId  String
  osTemplate    OsTemplate   @relation(fields: [osTemplateId], references: [id])
  jobs          Job[]
  portForwards  PortForward[]
  autoUpdate    Boolean      @default(false) // game-server auto-update opt-in
  claudeBuilds  ClaudeBuild[]
  gamePlanId    String?
  gamePlan      GamePlan?    @relation(fields: [gamePlanId], references: [id])
  ipv6          String?      // assigned IPv6 address
  autoBackup    Boolean      @default(false)
  backupIntervalHours Int?   // scheduled-backup cadence
  lastAutoBackup DateTime?
}

model PortForward {
  id         String  @id @default(cuid())
  serverId   String
  server     Server  @relation(fields: [serverId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  publicPort Int     @unique
  guestPort  Int
  protocol   String  @default("tcp")
}

model Job {
  id        String    @id @default(cuid())
  type      JobType
  status    JobStatus @default(QUEUED)
  payload   Json?
  error     String?
  attempts  Int       @default(0)
  serverId  String?
  server    Server?   @relation(fields: [serverId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt
}

model WalletTransaction {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId      String
  user        User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  amountCents Int
  description String
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
}

model AuditLog {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String?
  user      User?    @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id])
  action    String
  detail    String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

model Setting {
  key   String @id
  value String
}

## Summary

Built the three server-lifecycle extras for Nxeon, touching only my owned files.

### Files created
- **`lib/actions-server-lifecycle.ts`** (`"use server"`) — `setBackupSchedule`, `reinstallToOs`, `resizeServerDown`. Each is ownership-checked (`ownedServer` helper: `findUnique` + `userId`/ADMIN check) and honors the one-in-flight-job invariant.
- **`components/customer/BackupSchedule.tsx`** — toggle + frequency `<select>` (12h / daily / 2d / 3d / weekly), optimistic toggle with revert-on-error.
- **`components/customer/ReinstallOs.tsx`** — OS `<select>`, plan-fit warning, mandatory "type ERASE" gate plus a `window.confirm`, red danger styling.
- **`components/customer/ResizeDown.tsx`** — smaller-plans grid with disk-shrink guard and a live prorated-credit estimate.
- **`worker/backup-schedule.ts`** — exports `scheduledBackupSweep()`.

### Files edited (sole owner)
- **`app/dashboard/servers/[id]/page.tsx`** — added imports, fetch active `PLAIN_OS` templates in the `Promise.all`, mounted `BackupSchedule` into the Backups tab and `ResizeDown` + `ReinstallOs` into the Resize tab.
- `components/customer/ServerTabs.tsx` — no change needed; existing Backups/Resize tabs host the new panels.

### How each works
- **Scheduled backups**: action writes `autoBackup`/`backupIntervalHours` (null when disabled); `lastAutoBackup` is left untouched on enable so the first backup fires on the next sweep. `scheduledBackupSweep()` finds RUNNING servers with `autoBackup=true` whose `lastAutoBackup` is older than `backupIntervalHours` (or null), skips any with an in-flight job, enqueues `BACKUP_CREATE`, and stamps `lastAutoBackup=now` to anchor the next window and prevent duplicate piling.
- **Reinstall-to-different-OS**: validates target OS is active, not the current one, and that the plan meets `minRamMB`/`minDiskGB`; persists `Server.osTemplateId` **before** enqueuing `REINSTALL` (the worker's handler re-provisions from that field). Scoped to `PLAIN_OS` templates to avoid license/panel edge cases.
- **Resize-down**: downgrades only (`newPlan.priceCents < current`). **Disk-shrink guard** — blocks any plan whose `diskGB < current plan diskGB` with a clear message, because the worker's RESIZE handler hard-fails a disk shrink and hypervisors can't shrink disks non-destructively; CPU/RAM shrink freely on the next power cycle. **Proration**: credits `(currentTermPrice − newTermPrice) × remainingFraction` back to the wallet via `db.$transaction([user.update increment, walletTransaction.create, job.create RESIZE, auditLog])` (paid servers with an `expiresAt` only). Same remaining-term math as the existing upgrade path.

### INTEGRATION NEEDED (orchestrator / worker owner)
Wire the sweep into `worker/index.ts`'s main loop, mirroring the existing sweeps:
```ts
import { scheduledBackupSweep } from "./backup-schedule";
// add: let lastBackupSweep = 0;  then inside the for(;;) loop:
if (Date.now() - lastBackupSweep > 15 * 60_000) {
  lastBackupSweep = Date.now();
  try { await scheduledBackupSweep(); } catch (e) { console.error("[backup-schedule] sweep error", e); }
}
```
No worker `handlers` change is required — `BACKUP_CREATE` and `REINSTALL` handlers already exist.

### Risks / live-VM testing
- Did not run build/tsc/prisma per the hard rules — a typecheck pass is advisable.
- Reinstall/resize are destructive/disruptive; verify against a live VM: reinstall onto a different OS actually rebuilds cleanly, and resize-down power-cycles and applies smaller CPU/RAM.
- The client-side credit figure in `ResizeDown` is an estimate; the server recomputes authoritatively, so a small clock-skew difference is possible but harmless.
- I restricted reinstall to `PLAIN_OS` images by design; if switching into control-panel/app images is desired later, that needs license-requirement handling.
